scripts.text: We're looking for adventurers that can join us for a brand new adventure. If you're at the Level to accept IGU's quests, then you're qualified.
I'm Roel, new member of the White Wings Guild. Roter had me search everywhere for Newoz, and I've found some clues as to his whereabouts.
Recruiting guild prospects! Join us in our search for our former master Newoz! Are you interested?
What a difficult task. I searched from this end to that end of the world, and could find neither hide nor hair of him.
I tried to some trace of him, but to no avail.
Newoz is an avid adventurer who never stays in one place long enough; a lot of people claimed they saw him, yet none of them remembered where he went.
After a while, I had to give up on tracing him. I was just wasting time.
I turned my eyes to the Other World, and there I met some eyewitnesses. They led me to the last place Newoz had been seen.
The whole process was painful. If it weren't for Runane, we couldn't have Memorized his last location or gotten out of it.
If you're interested in joining us, please talk to Runane. We have an exciting adventure ahead of us.
If you're interested in joining us, please talk to Runane.
It was my first adventure as a member of White Wings. I can't wait for the next one!
Where do you think Shaloshi is by now? The space where we met Shaloshi is caught in a time loop, repeating the same events again and again.
Mingmin thinks the phenomenon has something to do with the Dimensional Crack and Shaloshi's ability.
I didn't quite understand her, but Runane said the portal to the place she Memorized is based on time instead of space.
If you want, you can go back in time and experience the same events. Do you want to embark on an adventure again?
You might have a different experience this time in this place full of unfathomable mysteries. Please ask Runane to open the portal for you.
This time, maybe you don't have to leave Shaloshi.
Are you ready yet? You can give up if you're not confident.
Adventuring is always fun. Be a great adventurer, okay?
^ff0000If you want to use my dimensional portal, then you first have to talk to Roel. The portal is not open for everyone.^000000
^ff0000You first must form/join a party of at least 1 person to enter this dungeon.^000000
^ff0000This dimensional portal cannot be accessed for 20 hours after your last access.^000000
The portal is now available for use.
^ff0000Please note that this portal cannot be accessed for 23 hours after your last access.^000000
^ff0000Your party leader has not yet created a Time Crack.^000000
Our adventure hasn't started yet, and I'm already hungry.
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
I told you, Newoz. We can't just let this go.
Considering the time and money we wasted on you, you deserve to be fed a basket full of poisonous mushrooms.
I'll explain everything. And enough with the poisonous mushrooms. I can't eat mushrooms at all.
Newoz, you can't eat anything but meat. Sigh, I'm glad you're safe.
You're the famous Newoz! Nice to meet you. My master told me many great things...
Enough. He's just an idiot with no sense of direction.
Wow, Newoz! Your eyes look puffier than ever.
Hello, Arang. How's Arirang? Heh. What brings you here?
Newoz, do you know how long you've been missing? We even recruited new guildsmen to find you, and...
Hi, nice to meet you. I'm honored to meet the famous Newoz in person.
H-hello, my name is Roel. Runane and I've joined the guild together. Nice to meet you.
In accordance with the Guild Policy, Article 8, I'm now the master of this guild, and you're just a member.
...That wasn't what I expected. Aren't you upset at all?
What did you expect? All he thinks about is adventure, monsters, and treasure.
Argh, is there a ghost? Or am I hearing things?
Whew, it's you Jack. Long time, no see, everyone.
This isn't a good time for chit-chat. I'm sensing something from the very floor where you're standing and where I'm hiding.
Jack, is that why you're hiding like a coward?
It comes natural for veteran thieves like me to hide themselves in potential enemy territories.
I'm not hiding because my sprite is not yet ready!
I agree with Jack. Everything about this place--from the air to the soil--screams unnatural.
You're Lagi, right? I like the way you think. I'd love to work with you sometime.
I've joined this guild to meet you, Newoz. Do you have a girlfriend?
Don't you dare--I called dibs on him first!
I don't think he knows that. Do you, Newoz?
Um, the conversation seems to have gone...
She can change subjects more quickly than an Arclouse can cast Increase AGI.
Are they competing over Newoz? I want in, too!
...Sorry to bother you guys, but I think something's over there.
Perhaps it's monsters. Do you want me to go check?
You stay here, kiddo. I'll go.
Newoz, you're like a magnet for crazy.
I can see what has made you become so irritable, Master.
Oh, shut it, both of you!
That reminds me, when Rot was younger...
Rot? Is that your pet name, Master? Are you two friends?
That Crack thing, or the entrance as you might call it, has vanished. If you really want to leave, then follow Aigu.
Stop pretending you care about me! I can take care of myself!
Oh, we've got new members, huh? Great, I have a few mushrooms that I've wanted to sample...
Roel, I think we should move too.
Arang, let's go. It's time for an adventure!
I hope there are lots of things to study.
Let's move before they forget about us.
I'm Roel, new guildsman. Nice to meet you.
Stop bothering me. Can't you see I'm hiding?!
I've followed Aigu all the way here.
You look new around here. Nice to meet ya!
He's bad news. Trouble follows him wherever he goes.
Oh, is he the famous Newoz?
This place gives me the heebie-jeebies.
Please, let there be no more surprises.
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
Um, I have a feeling something might spring out of nowhere to attack us.
Calm down. It's just a woman.
How did we get in, you asked?
No idea. How did you get in?
We got lost and now we're in a rift in spacetime. How did this happen?
We didn't have to be here if it weren't for someone.
Do you know Newoz? Let's take him out of here.
It's calloused because I dance. Heh heh.
Where's everyone? Have they gone somewhere else? Let's go in that direction.
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
I'm detecting electromagnetic waves up ahead. At least Grade E monsters.
Hey, what have you been reading these days?
Heh, Sci-Fi. There's a mechanical tool that works...
Stop talking and get ready to practice your special skills.
Ooh, this will be like reenacting a scene from the book, where monsters are rampaging.
Gelka, Ultra Special Skill No. 8: Wild Dance!
Hm, not good enough, Gelka. Don't let the guild business distract you from practice.
Where are the others? This is definitely not a run-of-the-mill cave.
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
Did you get lost by yourself again?
It's too dangerous, so take him with you.
I'm okay. Not the first time.
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
Newoz! Where did you go this time?
This place is like a maze. There are so many offshoots and clearings that I've lost count.
*Snort* You said the same thing about the Prontera Culvert.
What are you talking about? Why can't you just follow us? Where's Runane? I saw her next to me a moment ago.
Oh, hello. May I ask who you are, little lady?
Hah hah, you're cute. I'll sing for you later.
Monsters started appearing, and their number is growing quickly.
You'll be okay, Aigu, so long as you stick with us... Um, where's everyone?
Hah hah, don't worry, little ladies. I'll protect you.
You'd run before everyone else in here. Well, we can't stay here. Let's move on.
Monsters started appearing, and their number is growing quickly.
What's wrong with me? My heart won't stop pounding.
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
But it stayed long enough for us to lose each other.
One moment, I had Shaloshi's hand in my hand, and the next, she's gone.
Her name is Shaloshi? I asked her several times, and she didn't tell me.
That's strange. She told Newoz straight from the start.
Hmpf, I hate girls. I get the feeling we'll be seeing even more monsters.
You'd better be more reliable than someone I know.
Don't put too much faith in this kid. I'd better go look for Newoz.
Where do you think Newoz is this time?
I feel great--this is my first adventure in a long time since I was charged with caring for other adventurers. Plus I've met my hero Newoz!
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
Do you really have to ask? Who's that girl? Is she yours?
W-whazza...?! Don't be ridiculous. I just found her now.
A little girl in this strange place, by herself? Hm, doesn't it sound strange to you?
No, I'm not! You don't want me to get angry at you, girl.
These monsters don't stop coming. But where are all the big, rare, beautiful ones?
I'll have to study you later, girl.
I wonder what might wait for us at the end of this passage. The anticipation is killing me!
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
I keep losing the others. They were right in front of me.
You have good taste. This just came to my mind. Listen.
The seasons are changing once again~ yet I haven't had a chance to dye my nails with garden balsam~
You're good. You'll make great a Gypsy and Minstrel.
I want to stay as a Bard for a while.
I guess jobs don't matter so long as you can sing and play, huh?
Shaloshi, do you have a favorite song?
Runane sings even whistles good, too.
- Shaloshi puckers her lips to whistle, but fails. -
Um, are you trying to whistle?
Hah hah, I'll teach you how to do it later, Shaloshi.
{0}, do you have a favorite song?
Aigu's single- Only I Didn't Know about the Card Album
You know her debut song. You're a fan of her, huh?
Aigu is the Rune-Midgarts' hottest singer at this moment!
Hah hah, this is embarassing, but thank you.
But how...?! It's not released yet.
Ah, I'm getting hungry. The monsters can screw themselves. Shaloshi, let's go!
I'm not experienced in adventuring, but it's quite fun.
These guys are different. They seem to understand music... or maybe not.
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
Did you take care of them already? I wanted to take part in it!
They look cute, but they're ferocious.
Small friends follow us. Not cute.
They're monsters, not your friends. Be careful.
Could she have lost her memory? It seems she doesn't understand danger, it seems.
I've trained enough. I can be useful.
Never let your guard down while exploring, or you can get hurt.
Arang, why aren't you drinking it?
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
How long do I have to shimmy my shoulders~
Ugh, I don't want to drink this!
Just trust me and drink it!
What are you trying to feed this child? What's in this green bottle? ...No...
Green Potion is such a bitter... Um, Green Potion you said?
But you're singing a strange song, and... Green Potion?
I had an almost expired Green Potion, so we decided to play Rock-paper-scissors and feed it to the loser.
It doesn't do anything when you're not poisoned. We just didn't want to waste a good potion.
Roel, can't you drink it for your sister?
Let me go look for possible threats.
A stream of water has started flowing.
How long do I have to shimmy my shoulders~
Some scholars have proved the drop of rate of Poring card is.. percent.
I'm glad the mushroom is not poisonous.
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
Its interior looked like that of a forest, then changed to that of a cave. How strange.
Strange plants growing on stranger terrains. Everything looks out of place.
I've harvested a few mushrooms to taste.
This mushroom is poisonous, but not life threatening. Do you want to have a bite?
I won't take no for an answer!
- Mingmin shoves a mushroom into your mouth. -
You're not reacting. Maybe the mushroom is not poisonous after all. Maybe I should try one...
Sheesh, this was a waste of time. You should go first. There's one more thing I want to look at.
- You feel good, possibly a side effect of eating the mushroom. -
Sheesh, this was a waste of time. You should go first. There's one more thing I want to look at.
Suddenly I crave meat. I should have brought a container full of it!
You made it sound so difficult, when you could just say, 'give and take.'
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
Um, how did I manage to lose the others again?
And I thought you'd have gotten used to having me around invisible.
Guess so. We've been circling around the same place, by the way.
So I was right about this place being maze-like. Ugh, I'm getting hungry again.
I've waited for you because I wanted to talk.
Newoz, your contract has expired at the time you returned to the guild.
Oh, that's right. Since I'm no longer the master, my contract has expired naturally.
But given the situation, my promise to you still stands.
Thanks. I'm glad my contingency plan is still in place.
Hmpf, just know I'm keeping my promise to you only because you've got what I want.
Oh, do you mean this ukulele?
You moron, that's worth nothing. Your contract has expired, but a promise is a promise and I intend to keep it.
Please don't talk to me--I'm hiding for a reason.
It's possible someone else might be in here.
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
- Before the two give each other a high five, Aigu and Mingmin slap them on their backs. -
Stop goofing around. Shaloshi, talk to us.
In the pitch darkness, I heard a voice. It was low, but it was ringing for a while.
Later I heard Newoz singing while waiting for his friends. His voice warmed me.
You speak like a grown-up now, all smooth and clear.
I didn't know what friends meant, but it sounded good. I wanted it.
I thought someone made my wish come true.
The pitch darkness... Don't you remember anything else?
She could have had her eyes closed. Perhaps she's sleeping.
The pitch darkness... The cave is bright throughout, aside from the fog.
A dream. A low voice in a dream. What kind of dream?
She may have not remembered everything, but this is an improvement. Let's wait until she's ready to talk more.
A voice before my singing. It's possible someone else might be in here.
I think someone made my wish come true.
If you find my joke funny, don't try to hide it. Just laugh.
Don't listen to him. He doesn't need encouragement for his bad jokes.
I hope Shaloshi will recover her memory soon.
Ugh, I'm tired. Looking out for these new members all day is work in itself.
I miss the delectable combination of beef and acorns called Bifrost Roast Beef.
Don't worry. Children grow by fighting.
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
Where have you been? We just had an awesome monster here!
Heh, my instincts told me to slow down because danger was ahead.
Oh, the instincts of a great adventurer!
No, his adventurer instincts have gotten rusty.
He's just being lazy. He's not so weak.
My instincts just told me Newoz is not strong.
Newoz, did you just think everyone except Rot is mediocre?
You can talk and you can hear other people's thoughts. Brilliant.
Enough! Stop being disrespectful to Newoz!
Comrades should not fight with each other.
Comrades should not fight with each other. Got it.
Comrades, who? We're just a bunch of strangers hell-bent on saving a lost girl!
We'll talk again the moment we're out of here.
I never slack on my training.
Can't you hear what others think?
I bake and knit in my spare time. I'm very domestic. Ho ho ho!
It's true that I'm the strongest.
Wait, I've collected some Autumn Leaves and Blue Cards to give to other friends as souvenirs. Where are they?
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
Having you two with me brings back a lot of memories.
I was as stubborn as a mule and busy pretending like I knew what I was doing.
Do you remember when you two fought over that florist girl at the southern gate of Prontera? Or when the doll merchant at the eastern gate whupped you for bickering and driving his customers away?
Do you not have any good memories of us?
Oh, I remember! Ah, good times!
Am I the only one not happy about this conversation?
How about when you played with Dead Branch to death? Or when you and your Sorcerer buddies killed yourselves playing Hocus Pocus?
Can't you think of a nice memory?
I can! Mingmin drank the Poison Bottle I found on the street and died; I told you it was expensive, and I didn't say anything about it being good for your health.
Oh, I remember! That was funny!
Tsk, tsk. I practically raised everyone here, and now they're at each other's throughts over the guild master position.
Don't let yourself be deluded by rumors! I'm the Stag of the Southern Gate, the most powerful Bishop in exorcist history!
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
Maybe Newoz is not interested in dating.
Tell me something I don't know.
But you haven't tried to talk to him. I mean seriously, have you?
You've met him today, but you should know unless you're stupid.
I know--he'll say no if I ask him out.
That dimwit is only interested in adventuring.
Don't call my hero that! ...But I agree with you.
You seem to be fond of Roel.
I'm not interested in that kid.
How about you, Adventurer? How are things with your significant other?
You don't even know if I have one.
Oh, I'm sorry, but I'm on the verge of bursting into tears.
Unrequited love is painful. You'd better let it go before it breaks you.
Are you serious? Even people like you have found their love. What about me?!
I don't mind healthy rivalry, but I prefer friendship, however long it lasts.
Let's make a truce for now. But make no mistake--Newoz is mine the moment I find him vulnerable.
Let's make a truce for now. But make no mistake--Newoz is mine the moment I find him vulnerable.
I don't mind healthy rivalry, but I prefer friendship, however long it lasts.
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
I'm fine. I told you to be careful, kiddo!
Sorry. I won't disappoint you again.
She's not happy with him, but she still treats him really well.
Don't mistake this for anything more than what it is--babysitting!
There's nothing about you I like.
They emit 'ferre, ferre,' so I call them Ferres.
They're my friends. They don't bite or hurt me.
Listen, humans and monsters can't be friends. At least that's what I think.
That's right. I like you better when you listen to me.
How about I be your friend?
Stop making things awkward! We're about the same age, so we're friends already.
True friends don't need to declare their friendship; they just become friends without knowing.
I'm okay. At least I can protect Shaloshi. Feeling protective of someone is nice.
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
The air smells different, and things look less... perceptible.
It seems as though we're underwater, yet I don't feel it.
I'm telling you, we've been circling around the same place.
I agree. And this clearing is neither compact nor spacious.
Do you think it's meaningless for us to go deeper?
No. I'm just saying the environmental changes are too drastic, almost like the mood swings of a bipolar person.
I don't know why, but things are losing their shape as if they're fading away.
All the while, the foreign energy I've been sensing is growing stronger. This is bad.
I feel like something's going to appear in front of our eyes with a loud pop.
I hope it's a formidable monster!
I'm just going to leave you guys to...
I'll kill you both before the monster.
Have you seen Shaloshi? Where is she?
I have a feeling Newoz is up to no good.
We'd better look for an exit before things get too crazy.
Newoz's enthusiasm for adventure went overboard. Again. I can't say I hate that about him, though.
I wish these monsters were as cute and helpless as those Porings for the Taekwon mission.
They're bickering all the time, but look like good friends. Don't they?
I practice hard, so I can shine in times of danger.
One of my friends once set me up on a blind date in Izlude.
She and I exchanged a couple of letters, first to introduce each other, and then the second to set up a date.
She didn't reply to my second letter. I can't fAigure out why.
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
Scene 8: Heroes are surrounded by a horde of enemies. Roel, let's choreograph what we've practiced today, shall we?
By the gods, Gelka, you're awesome!
You just made up those words to look cool!
I hope you'll teach me too, Roter.
Special skills are all about their names. Shouting impressive names is enough to intimidate your enemies.
You're a spoilsport, you know that?
- They're absorbed in talking about their new special skills. -
Fighting is essential to adventurer training. Divide and conquer!
Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
I'm afraid this place is falling down around us.
Wow, you can even hear what monsters think?
No, they're not. Friends don't attack each other!
They're just trying to protect me.
We're going to be buried in here. Let's find an exit.
Newoz, I've known you're weird in the head, but she's...
I know. You don't have to remind me.
Then let's get out of here. We're in serious danger right now.
I have to find her. I have to talk to her.
I'm not your master anymore. You don't have to follow me.
We'll find Newoz and Shaloshi. And when we do, I'm going to kill both of them.
Newoz, did you know this would happen? You're lucky to have such good friends.
He didn't know because he doesn't think, ever.
We'll split into two teams. Be careful not to lose your way in the maze-like offshoots.
I knew this would happen, and Aigu didn't listen to me!
*Grunt* Why did I get myself into this mess?
We should find Newoz and Shaloshi first.
I'll follow you guys to the ends of the world.
I hope today won't be the last day I play my instrument...
I'll show you my charismatic leadership as the guild master!
*Pant Pant* I'm glad you didn't make it too far.
*Pant Pant* I'm glad you didn't make it too far.
You don't have to get upset. I'm not here to take your friend away. I just want...
Yeah, you don't have to tell me that.
Ferre has transformed into its true form!
Ferre, you don't have to do this!
Well, if I can't talk him out of this, then we'll have to duke it out.
Where are the others? Hey new guys, help me out here. That Ferre looks like he can pack a punch.
I like his spirit, though I can see he's getting exhausted.
Newoz, you're alive! Good, because I'm going to kill...
I'm all right. Rot, were you worried about me?
Wow, this place is not going to last long--look how violently the ground is shaking! We really need to get out like yesterday, Newoz.
He's not dead. Guys, I understand you're new, but you can't make mistakes like this.
Better get rid of him quickly.
Ferre created this space in the Crack for me. If he loses his mind or perishes, this space will disappear with everything in it.
I should have plenty of time before that to get rid of you. I'll show you why I'm called the Bad Boy of the Exorcist World.
If I take Ferre with me to a different space, then a number of exits will appear in the loosened rift in spacetime.
You're smart and capable of teleportation. Roter, we can't let her go.
I shouldn't have led you here, but I really wanted some friends.
Now I should be honest with you. I remember everything now. Let me introduce myself again.
I'm Shaloshi, a demon mind reader and the third agent of Morocc's.
...I'm free now, but that doesn't change who I am: a demon.
I enjoyed your company. If we meet again... Will we be enemies?
No, Shaloshi. As of today, you're a new member of Newoz's White Wings Guild.
Who says you can invite her? I'm not taking in a demon!
Guildsmen can bicker with each other, but they're still family.
...Thank you, Adventurer Newoz. If I find some interesting place, can I invite you over?
I think I have the ability to take people with me, wherever I go. Or you wouldn't have followed me this far.
Don't you dare take away my Newoz!
Shaloshi, I don't care who you are. You're my friend, and I'm yours.
Thank you. If only I knew how to express my feelings...
Bye, friends. I hope we'll meet again soon.
Don't look at me. Is that an exit?
It's been a while since I had so much fun.
This was my first adventure with my old friends in a long time. I hope we can do this again soon.
Newoz. Need I remind you this guild is no longer called Newoz's White Wings?
What? Did you change the guild name?
Of course! Now it's called... Um...
Stop thinking and just keep the old name.
Nope, I'm going to call it Roter's Super Critical Guild!
I'm not a fan of it.
I'm the guild master! I name it whatever I want!
I'm not a member, but if you ask me, that name...
I'll never be able to speak that name. Aigu, are you sure you want to stick with these guys?
I don't care. I'm staying with Newoz.
I just don't like the name.
Shush! We've had enough for a day. You all are dismissed! This concludes the adventure of Roter's Super Critical Guild!
Our deal is done. Let me think about what I want in return...
I will! I'll practice harder, too!
I want to go home. I really want to take a shower and eat some bread.
You're a prospect for now. Work hard for the guild, and I might promote you one day.
I'll never again let you go, Newoz!
I've found so much inspiration through this adventure. I'm hopeful I can write some good songs.
Roel and I are friends now. Heh.
I want to dance as well as Aigu.
I've stolen a few strands of hair from Shaloshi, thinking it'd come in handy someday. I want to analyze them, though I already know the results.
I think I can fit Pendant of Harmony and Pendant of Chaos together.
And if I do, the results will be incredible!
Magic attacks from enemies cast Level 1 Auto Spell Maelstrom.
If my description of the combination results is strangely familiar to you, I wouldn't know. But that's how I picture the results. If you find both the pendants, bring them to me, yeah?
Oooh, you've got some nice pendants. Do you want to combine them? It's failproof, I guarantee.
The combining process is really simple. I just place the Pendant of Harmony on the ground, then throw the Pendant of Chaos at it... like this!
*Chuckle* I was messing with you--it worked!
I can't tell you just yet, but they're useful to me. Bring them to me, and I'll give you some booty Newoz has hoarded in return.
What exactly am I offering? Gigantic Bow, Storm Bow, and ^FF0000other valuable things found in this space.^000000 If you want them, bring me at least 50 Jitterbug Teeth.
I'll exchange 50 Jitterbug Teeth with ^FF0000a random item.^000000
I won't accept anything less than 50 Jitterbug Teeth.
All right! Let me think about what I want to give you...
Enjoy your item. Bring more Jitterbug Teeth if you want more items.
This place is still full of things to study.
